Nobody prepares you for the sheer vulnerability of packing that hospital bag. 🥹🤍🎒

I remember holding a tiny newborn outfit in my hands at 8 months pregnant, completely overwhelmed by how fragile he would be. In the middle of all that self-doubt, the one essential I packed with blind trust was Pampers Premium Care to protect his day-one sensitive skin.

Five months later, that trust hasn’t wavered once. 🕊️

Let’s be honest, at 5 months, babies still wake up at night. Ivaan wakes up when his tummy needs a feed, but what makes all the difference is that he never wakes up crying from a damp, leaky diaper or skin irritation.

From Good Night to Good Morning, Pampers Premium Care Pants keep his skin completely dry and breathable through every kick, roll, and stretch. He feeds, snuggles back in, and drifts straight to sleep without any disruptive diaper changes. 🌙✨

Because when nighttime feeds are calm and dry, a mother finally gets the quiet space her body needs to heal. 🤍

Comment ‘Pampers’ and I’ll share the link with you to make your nights as calm as possible.
